# PixiJS 8.22.0

`pixi-8.22.0.min.js` is the unmodified browser distribution from the npm package `pixi.js@8.22.0`, obtained with `npm pack pixi.js@8.22.0`. Its MIT license is included in `LICENSE`.

Pinned and hosted locally so the standalone game and Hub iframe do not need a third-party CDN or a build step. Only the capybara garden loads it.

Official references: https://pixijs.com/8.x/guides/components/application and https://pixijs.com/8.x/guides/components/textures.
